name: TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd.
summary: TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale of used kitchen equipment in Japan. The company sells new and recycled cooking utensils, tableware, chairs, tables, kitchen equipment, commercial furniture, consumables, promotional items, and other kitchen appliances to restaurant owners through its retail stores, online, and direct sales. It also manages restaurants; and develops franchise locations.
